Fixed rate offers this spring

Example Lender has reduced its two year fixed rate to 5.79% p.a. for owner occupiers borrowing up to 80% of the value of the property. The comparison rate is 6.44% p.a. The offer applies to applications received before the end of November.

Investors pay 5.99% p.a. for the same term. A rate lock fee of $395 applies if the rate is locked at application.

Borrowers with a deposit under 20% pay lenders mortgage insurance, which can be added to the loan.
